newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul exchange forms mkt for firms under watch.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul exchange forms mkt for firms under watch.

text.p: The Istanbul Stock Exchange said on Wednesday it would open a new market on December 4 for companies to be put under watch amid extraordinary circumstances to protect investors' rights.

It said the Exchange board could decide to move the shares of a company to the "underwatch market" if the company failed to comply with the Exchange's disclosure and other rules or faced problems that could lead to suspension of trade in its shares.
The new market will provide continuous supervision and inspection of a company under watch and also allow investors to be informed about the company's situation in time.
Investors will have access to an organised market where they can liquidate the shares of such companies rather than facing unexpected trading suspensions, the Exchange said.
Three companies currently on the regional market -- knitwear producer Soksa, pipe producer Dogusan Boru and electromechanical equipment maker Abana --- will initially be listed on the new market.

Trading in Dogusan and Soksa have been suspended since November 8 due to investigation of alleged manipulation by the Exchange and the Capital Markets Board. Trade in Abana shares was also suspended on Wednesday.
